steps.finding: Not on FDA's current shortage list.

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.
steps.finding: 26 inspections (7 OAI at our plants), 3 compliance actions, 3 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 145 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: Vecuronium bromide has been on FDA's shortage list since 2020-05-06 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 78 months.
Our current supply includes labels naming Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited, both of which are registered plants for this product.
Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has a history of OAI inspections, including inspection 1112832 ending 2019-12-13 and inspection 1272871 ending 2025-06-13, both classified OAI.
Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited received an OAI classification letter dated 2026-09-21, 2329 days after the shortage posting.
The preferred purchasing option per rule is to buy from Mylan Institutional LLC, whose product is not on FDA's shortage list today and is manufactured at MYLAN LABS LTD.
An approved therapeutic interchange exists for the same product from Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083013910), approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-01-27.

rejected.text: FDA inspection 1112832 at Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited ended 2019-12-13 and was classified OAI, 145 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2020-05-06.
